name: 'Mao suit'
dimensions: Length 75 cm; Width 66 cm; Length 60 cm
summary: This style of suit was initially known as a 'Zhongshan suit' after Sun Zhongshan (Sun Yat-sen), President of the Republic of China for a brief period in 1912. Sun Yat-sen first developed this suit as a form of national dress that would embody modern values as well as a notion of equality and uniform
